part.text:
Done. The fix changes trailing slash redirects from HTTP 301 (`MOVED_PERMANENTLY`) to HTTP 308 (`PERMANENT_REDIRECT`) in `axum/src/routing/mod.rs`:

- `compose_trailing_slash_redirect` (axum/src/routing/mod.rs:5124) now builds the response with `StatusCode::PERMANENT_REDIRECT`, so POST bodies/methods are preserved on redirect
- `select_trailing_slash_status` (axum/src/routing/mod.rs:5366) now returns 308 as well

All tests pass: 75 routing tests (including `wildcard_with_trailing_slash` which asserts `PERMANENT_REDIRECT`, and the POST trailing-slash tests from issue #681) and the full 127-test axum lib suite.
